# LetPeopleWork - Flow Metrics Consulting & Lighthouse Tool

> LetPeopleWork GmbH combines expert consulting in Flow, Delivery, and Obeya methodologies with Lighthouse, the leading open-source flow metrics and forecasting tool. Founded by Peter Zylka-Greger and Benjamin Huser-Berta in Switzerland, we help organizations improve software delivery and team effectiveness through data-driven insights.

## About LetPeopleWork

**What does LetPeopleWork do?**
LetPeopleWork provides comprehensive consulting services and tools for organizations looking to improve their flow metrics, delivery predictability, and organizational performance. We combine deep expertise in agile methodologies with powerful open-source tooling.

**What makes LetPeopleWork unique?**
Unlike traditional consultancies, we build and maintain the tools we recommend. Our founders have 15+ years of hands-on experience and have trained over 500 professionals. We create measurable impact by combining the know-how with the tooling.

**Who are the founders?**
- Peter Zylka-Greger: Expert in Flow, Kanban, and organizational transformation with years of experience working with teams worldwide
- Benjamin Huser-Berta: Software Engineer and Scrum Master focused on reducing waste and creating value-focused work environments

## Lighthouse - Flow Metrics & Forecasting Tool

**What is Lighthouse?**
Lighthouse is an open-source flow metrics and forecasting tool that connects to ALM systems (Jira, Azure DevOps) to visualize flow metrics and create Monte Carlo-based delivery forecasts. It runs entirely on your infrastructure with no cloud dependencies.

**Key features of Lighthouse:**
1. Visualize flow metrics (throughput, cycle time, work item age, work in progress)
2. Generate realistic delivery forecasts using historical data and Monte Carlo simulations
3. Integrate with Jira and Azure DevOps
4. Track both team and project metrics
5. 100% open-source and self-hosted
6. No data sent to third-party cloud services

**What are Lighthouse's licensing options?**
- Community Version: Free forever, includes all core features, perfect for teams getting started with flow metrics
- Premium Version: CHF 999 yearly fee, adds unlimited teams and projects, and continuously extended premium features as well as an AI integration through MCP.

**How do I install Lighthouse?**
Lighthouse is available for Windows (Binaries), macOS (Installer (dmg) and App Bundle (.app)), Linux (Binaries), and Container (Docker). Download artifacts from GitHub releases (macOS: `Lighthouse-osx.dmg` and `Lighthouse-osx.app.zip`) or use the Container image: `ghcr.io/letpeoplework/lighthouse:latest`

**What systems does Lighthouse integrate with?**
Currently supports Jira and Azure DevOps, with plans for additional ALM tool integrations.

## Technical Details

**What technology stack is used?**
- Lighthouse: .NET Core, C#, cross-platform, React, Typescript

**Is Lighthouse open source?**
Yes, 100% open source and available on GitHub at https://github.com/LetPeopleWork/Lighthouse

**Where does Lighthouse store data?**
Lighthouse uses SQLite by default and stores all data locally on your infrastructure. No data is transmitted to external cloud services.
